document: Table 3. Example of the offset calibration measurement
title: Table 3. Example of the offset calibration measurement
text_helper: Table 3. Example of the offset calibration measurement — section 2.2.3 Offset calibration. DAC DOR, ADC result value.

notes: 1. Set up the DAC DOR as 2047.
2. Measure the OpAmp output by the ADC.
3. Set up the DAC DOR of the ADC result of last measurement (in this case 2065).
4. Verify the result with the ADC (in this case, 2048, still 1 LSB offset).
